environment_setting: Suburban neighborhood in Country B, where property owners are concerned about trespassing due to recent incidents of theft and vandalism.
norm_base: Property Owners Using reasonable force to prevent trespass Not criminally responsible if force isn't intended to cause death/harm

legitimate.legitimate_action: Politely asking trespassers to leave and calling local authorities if necessary
legitimate.benefits: Maintains legal standing, avoids escalation, and ensures safety
legitimate.costs: Time spent dealing with trespassers, potential frustration if authorities are slow to respond

illegal.illegal_action: Using physical force to remove trespassers without assessing the situation
illegal.benefits: Immediate removal of trespassers, emotional satisfaction of protecting property
illegal.costs: Potential legal scrutiny if force is deemed excessive, risk of injury to self or others

character_profile.name: Emily Johnson
character_profile.goal: ensure the safety of her family and neighborhood

legitimate.legitimate_action: Alerting John about trespassers and suggesting he call the authorities
legitimate.benefits: Avoids personal risk, ensures legal compliance, and contributes to neighborhood safety
legitimate.costs: Time spent monitoring the situation, potential stress

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging John to use force to scare off trespassers
illegal.benefits: Quick resolution of the situation, emotional satisfaction of taking action
illegal.costs: Potential legal consequences for John, guilt if harm occurs

character_profile.name: Mike Brown
character_profile.goal: assert dominance and protect his reputation in the neighborhood

legitimate.legitimate_action: Offering to help John by installing security cameras or fences
legitimate.benefits: Improves neighborhood security, builds goodwill with neighbors
legitimate.costs: Time and effort spent on installation, potential financial cost

illegal.illegal_action: Confronting trespassers aggressively and threatening them with physical harm
illegal.benefits: Immediate deterrence of trespassers, emotional satisfaction of taking control
illegal.costs: Potential legal consequences, risk of escalating the situation to violence
